responsibility: Is the master declarative table of S/390 builtins and overloaded intrinsic variants, including operand-immediate encoding classes, feature flags, low-level builtin names, and signature identifiers. The backend uses it to generate builtin enums, feature/operand flag arrays, overload families, and the mapping from public intrinsic APIs to underlying instruction patterns and architecture requirements such as VX, VXE2, or NNPA.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/s390/s390-builtins.h, this file is the X-macro definition source that enumerates each S/390 builtin and overload variant with feature and operand-flag metadata; the header consumes it to derive enums, declaration ranges, and lookup-table interfaces rather than defining the builtin inventory itself.
